_comment: LandfallElementals claude-play sweep flag E/C (2026-10-19, seed 61003 T4): the restricted-first
payer must not strand the declared line. Smokebraider (untapped, could attack), Myriad Landscape and
two Mountains; hand Brushfire Elemental (1/1 haste, landfall +2/+2); opponent at 5; resumed at main 1
of T4 so no land is drawn. Exact lethal T4 ONLY by: Smokebraider pays ALL of Brushfire's {R}{G} (its
two Elemental-only units), the two Mountains pay Myriad's {2} crack, two Mountains enter -> two
landfalls -> Brushfire 5/5 hasty swing for 5. The old payer held Smokebraider for its attack, spent a
Mountain on {R}, tapped Smokebraider for {G} only (its second unit floating Elemental-only), and the
